# onpager_rbac_role (Data Source)

Read one OnPager rbac role through authorized configuration reads. Absence, ambiguity and denied reads are errors. Reads never modify configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "onpager_rbac_role" "example" {
  key = "configuration_reader"
}

output "role_id" {
  value = data.onpager_rbac_role.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Stable OnPager UUID. Configure exactly one identity selector. Must be a nonzero canonical lowercase UUID; computed when another selector is configured.
- `key` (String) Exact immutable key. Configure exactly one identity selector. Maximum 4096 UTF-8 bytes; computed when another selector is configured.

### Read-Only

- `builtin` (Boolean) Whether this is a builtin role. Use its stable key for portable configuration; builtin UUIDs belong to an installation.
- `description` (String) Observed role description; an empty string is preserved.
- `name` (String) Observed role name. Builtin and custom roles are readable.
- `permission_keys` (Set of String) Observed explicit native permission keys. Reading a role grants no permissions.
- `scope_type` (String) Observed native role scope: `tenant` or `team`.

## Selection

Configure exactly one of `id` or `key`. The immutable key is unique within the
tenant and can select a built-in or custom role. Use a stable key for portable
configuration because built-in role UUIDs belong to an installation. The
provider preserves the configured key without trimming or changing case.

Key lookups use an exact server-side filter with `limit=2`. Zero matches,
multiple matches or `has_more` produce a diagnostic. The key is limited to 4096
UTF-8 bytes and the full JSON filter to 8192 bytes. UUID selection reads the
role directly and bypasses these filter limits.

The unique match is read directly by UUID before its metadata is returned.

## Read behavior

Reads role metadata, scope and permission keys. Built-in roles can be read even
though `onpager_rbac_role` manages only custom roles. Roles have no inactive
state; deleted roles are absent. Missing roles, denied access, malformed
responses and transport failures produce diagnostics.

## Permissions

Requires the tenant grant `roles.read` for personal tokens and service accounts.
